prompt: For the STEM OPT online application: Do I also need to upload a copy of my post-completion I-20 in addition to the STEM I-20?
response: Yes, you should upload a copy of your post-completion I-20 along with the STEM I-20 for the STEM OPT online application. This ensures that all necessary documents are on file, even though the post-completion I-20 isn't directly related to the STEM OPT extension.
